answer: Roughly 1 second of fixed overhead per cycle on a typical cluster, for planning and committing source offsets. At a 2 s trigger, that is about half the time (50%) on overhead. At a 100 ms trigger, overhead dominates: about 1 s of overhead against a 100 ms interval, so roughly 90% or more of the time (the lesson says 'almost all'). Source: pa_pattern_batch_or_stream_intermediate.md, section 'Micro-batch or True Streaming?' (L345-346).
